title: utter plugin manifest
description: Manifest for a utter plugin. The canonical on-disk form is utter-plugin.toml; this schema validates its JSON equivalent. Framing/handshake are frozen in protocol/PROTOCOL.md.

protocol.description: Wire protocol version this plugin implements (major.minor).

max_protocol.description: Optional upper bound on protocol major.minor.

runtime.description: Execution runtime. The reference runner supports only 'subprocess'; 'wasm'/'native' are reserved and rejected today (runner/plugin.py).

transport.description: stdio = runner spawns it. connect/listen = persistent unix-socket plugin.

entrypoint.description: argv for subprocess, or a .wasm path for wasm.

provides.description: Capabilities this plugin offers, versioned name@N (see protocol/capabilities.json).

requires.description: Capabilities the runner must provide. A missing require is an error (fail closed).

permissions.description: Gated capabilities. Enforced where possible; otherwise labelled advisory in doctor.

source.description: e.g. hf:org/repo, https URL, or registry ref.

path.description: Expected install path relative to the model store.

config_schema.description: Path (relative to the plugin) to a JSON Schema describing the plugin's settings.

settings.description: Inline defaults for settings. Declaration-only today: the reference runner does not validate these against config_schema (validation is planned; see docs/COMPATIBILITY.md §5).
